statement_html:
We have 4 integers \(a\), \(b\), \(c\), \(d\) such that
  • The average of \(a\) and of \(b\) is 155.
  • The average of \(b\) and of \(c\) is -385.
  • The average of \(c\) and of \(d\) is -474.
What is the average of \(d\) and of \(a\) ?

hint_html:
For which value of \(t\) the following linear system has a solution?
\(\left\lbrace\begin{array}{ccccc} 0.5a&+&0.5b&=&155\\0.5a&+&0.5c&=&-385\\0.5c&+&0.5d&=&-474\\0.5c&+&0.5a&=&t\\\end{array}\right.\)
